title: Product Photography for Dallas Brands
metaTitle: Product Photography for Dallas Brands | TDM
metaDescription: Product shoots for Dallas brands: catalog, lifestyle and detail images for stores, marketplaces, line sheets and ads, photographed in the US by TDM's own team.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) photographs products for Dallas brands: clean studio images for catalogs and marketplaces, styled lifestyle scenes and close detail shots. The photography is done in the United States by our own US-based team, in a setting chosen for the range, though we keep no studio or office in Dallas itself. You approve the shot list and art direction beforehand, and the images are retouched at our operations office in Lahore and delivered digitally in the formats each channel needs. It suits Dallas brands that sell to retailers, on their own online store, on Amazon, or through all three.

sections.heading: A wholesale city needs more than one set of pictures
paragraphs: Dallas has an unusual number of brands that sell to other businesses first. Around the Dallas Market Center there are companies in gifts, home decor, lighting, apparel and accessories whose year is organised around market dates. They need images for line sheets and wholesale catalogs, for the retailers who will list the product on their own websites, and for the brand's direct store and advertising. Each use has different requirements, and one hurried set of photographs rarely serves all of them.

A retailer wants a consistent white-background image that drops into its site. A marketplace has strict rules on background, framing and size. A consumer advert needs the product in a setting, at a scale people can judge, with a detail that shows quality. Planning the shoot around these outputs once is cheaper than photographing the range three times.

sections.heading: What the shoot includes
paragraphs: We plan the set list with you before anything is photographed, so every product has a defined list of angles and uses.
bullets: Art direction and a shot list agreed in advance, with reference images.
Studio catalog photography on white or brand-coloured backgrounds, consistent across the range.
Styled lifestyle scenes with props and surfaces chosen to suit your customer.
Macro and detail shots of texture, stitching, finishes and packaging.
Retouching, colour correction and colour matching between variants.
Export for your store, Amazon and other marketplaces, wholesale catalogs and each ad placement.

sections.heading: Planning a shoot around a market date
paragraphs: Work back from the date you need the images, such as a market week, a seasonal launch or a retailer's deadline, and leave room for the shoot, the retouching and a round of changes. Supply samples in final packaging, since prototypes photograph differently from finished stock, and include every colourway and size that needs its own image. Tell us which items are fragile, reflective or need assembling, because glass, polished metal and light fittings take longer to light well than a boxed candle.

Our team in the United States checks the samples before the session and tells you if anything is marked, dented or missing, so a replacement can be found before the camera is set up. The photographs then pass to our retouchers in Lahore, who remove dust and creases, correct colour and match variants across the range. Agree with us beforehand what should happen to the samples afterwards.

sections.heading: What to ask a product photographer
paragraphs: Ask whether retouching is included and how many images per product you will receive. Ask who holds the usage rights and whether they cover advertising. Ask whether the files will be delivered in marketplace-ready sizes or whether you will have to resize them yourself.

faqs.q: Do you have a product photography studio in Dallas?
faqs.a: No, there is no TDM studio or office in Dallas. Your products are photographed in the United States by our own US-based team, in a setting chosen to suit the range, and the retouching is done at our operations office in Lahore. You approve the shot list and art direction before the session.

faqs.q: How much does product photography cost for a Dallas brand?
faqs.a: It varies with scope: the number of products, the images per product and the mix of studio and lifestyle shots. You receive a quote after a free consultation.

faqs.q: Can you prepare images for line sheets and for Amazon from the same shoot?
faqs.a: Yes. We plan the shot list around every place the images will be used, so a single session can supply wholesale catalogs, retailer websites, marketplace listings and adverts.

faqs.q: Do our products have to leave the United States to be photographed?
faqs.a: No. The photography is done in the United States by our team. Only the image files travel: they go to our operations office in Lahore for retouching, colour correction and export. Very large, fragile or perishable items need extra planning before a date is set.

faqs.q: How long before a market date should we start?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of the range and the brief. The schedule is agreed in the plan, and starting early leaves room for samples that arrive late from the factory and for a round of changes.
